name: Tactical Missile Corporation, Concern “MPO – Gidropribor”
aliases: Joint Stock Company Concern Sea Underwater Weapons Gidropribor

evidence.summary: The US Commerce Department added it to the Entity List in April 2022 as “Tactical Missile Corporation, Concern “MPO – Gidropribor””, a unit of the Tactical Missiles Corporation (KTRV), which the US Treasury calls a large, state-owned Russian defence conglomerate. The Treasury lists Joint Stock Company Concern Sea Underwater Weapon Gidropribor, a maker of naval underwater weapons, among the 28 entities that are part of KTRV’s structure.
It belongs to the Tactical Missiles Corporation (KTRV), a Russian state-owned defence conglomerate.

sources.title: Additions of Entities to the Entity List (87 FR 20295, 7 April 2022)
sources.publisher: US Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry and Security (Federal Register)

sources.title: U.S. Treasury Sanctions Russia’s Defense-Industrial Base, the Russian Duma and Its Members, and Sberbank CEO (24 March 2022)

history.change: Record created from its listing on the US Entity List and the Section 1286 list; not yet verified.
